name: Last Chance Audubon Habitat Protection Grants
summary: Small grants from a Montana Audubon chapter to local groups for habitat protection, enhancement or restoration projects in the Helena area.

applicant_types.quote: LCAS accepts grant applications from local groups interested in promoting the protection or enhancement of habitat that has, or could have, significant value for birds and other wildlife.

geography.quote: Each year the Last Chance Audubon Society (LCAS) grants funds to Helena area projects for habitat protection, enhancement or restoration.

access.quote: LCAS accepts grant applications from local groups interested in promoting the protection or enhancement of habitat
